newsitem.title: USA: Source One Mortgage tenders for notes.
newsitem.headline: Source One Mortgage tenders for notes.

text.p: Source One Mortgage Services Corp on Wednesday commenced a tender offer for its $138.4 million oustanding 8-7/8 percent notes due 2001, according to Salomon Brothers, manager for the offer.
The offer will expire at 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on May 15, unless extended, Salomon said.

A price set will result from a yield to maturity equal to a fixed spread of 40 basis points over the yield to maturity of the 6-3/8 percent U.S. Treasury note due September 30, 2001, at the time the holder agrees to tender.

Holders of a majority in aggregate principal amount of the notes have consented to certain amendments which will eliminate or modify most of the restrictive covenants in the current indenture, the manager said.
